instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 达仁堂2024FY与2023FY营业总收入同比变化
output: SELECT a.report_period AS current_period, a.total_operating_revenue AS current_val, b.total_operating_revenue AS prior_val, (a.total_operating_revenue - b.total_operating_revenue) / ABS(b.total_operating_revenue) * 100 AS yoy_growth FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet a JOIN core_performance_indicators_sheet b ON a.stock_abbr = b.stock_abbr WHERE a.stock_abbr = '达仁堂' AND a.report_period = '2024FY' AND b.report_period = '2023FY';

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 东阿阿胶2024FY与2023FY营业总收入同比变化
output: SELECT a.report_period AS current_period, a.total_operating_revenue AS current_val, b.total_operating_revenue AS prior_val, (a.total_operating_revenue - b.total_operating_revenue) / ABS(b.total_operating_revenue) * 100 AS yoy_growth FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet a JOIN core_performance_indicators_sheet b ON a.stock_abbr = b.stock_abbr WHERE a.stock_abbr = '东阿阿胶' AND a.report_period = '2024FY' AND b.report_period = '2023FY';

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 康泰医学2024FY与2023FY营业总收入同比变化

output: SELECT a.report_period AS current_period, a.total_operating_revenue AS current_val, b.total_operating_revenue AS prior_val, (a.total_operating_revenue - b.total_operating_revenue) / ABS(b.total_operating_revenue) * 100 AS yoy_growth FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet a JOIN core_performance_indicators_sheet b ON a.stock_abbr = b.stock_abbr WHERE a.stock_abbr = '九芝堂' AND a.report_period = '2024Q4' AND b.report_period = '2023Q4';

output: SELECT c.stock_abbr, c.total_operating_revenue, c.net_profit_10k_yuan, c.roe, b.asset_total_assets, b.asset_liability_ratio, i.operating_expense_rnd_expenses, cf.operating_cf_net_amount FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet c JOIN balance_sheet b ON c.stock_abbr = b.stock_abbr AND c.report_period = b.report_period JOIN income_sheet i ON c.stock_abbr = i.stock_abbr AND c.report_period = i.report_period JOIN cash_flow_sheet cf ON c.stock_abbr = cf.stock_abbr AND c.report_period = cf.report_period WHERE c.stock_abbr = '新光药业' AND c.report_period = '2025Q3';

output: SELECT c.stock_abbr, c.stock_code, i.operating_expense_rnd_expenses, c.total_operating_revenue, i.operating_expense_rnd_expenses / c.total_operating_revenue * 100 AS rnd_pct FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet c JOIN income_sheet i ON c.stock_abbr = i.stock_abbr AND c.report_period = i.report_period WHERE c.report_period = '2025Q3' AND i.operating_expense_rnd_expenses > 0 ORDER BY rnd_pct DESC LIMIT 5;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 瑞康医药2024Q4与2023Q4营业总收入同比变化

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 精华制药2024Q4与2023Q4净利润同比变化
output: SELECT a.report_period AS current_period, a.net_profit_10k_yuan AS current_val, b.net_profit_10k_yuan AS prior_val, (a.net_profit_10k_yuan - b.net_profit_10k_yuan) / ABS(b.net_profit_10k_yuan) * 100 AS yoy_growth FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet a JOIN core_performance_indicators_sheet b ON a.stock_abbr = b.stock_abbr WHERE a.stock_abbr = '精华制药' AND a.report_period = '2024Q4' AND b.report_period = '2023Q4';

output: SELECT stock_abbr, stock_code, gross_profit_margin FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet WHERE report_period = '2024FY' AND gross_profit_margin > 30 ORDER BY gross_profit_margin DESC;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 仁和药业2025Q3与2024Q3营业总收入同比变化
output: SELECT a.report_period AS current_period, a.total_operating_revenue AS current_val, b.total_operating_revenue AS prior_val, (a.total_operating_revenue - b.total_operating_revenue) / ABS(b.total_operating_revenue) * 100 AS yoy_growth FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet a JOIN core_performance_indicators_sheet b ON a.stock_abbr = b.stock_abbr WHERE a.stock_abbr = '仁和药业' AND a.report_period = '2025Q3' AND b.report_period = '2024Q3';

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
